{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "winterrdog",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Tested ACK on FreeBSD; previously raised owner-only permissions question settled by umask explanation"
    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "concept ACK; pointed out space injection vector in ADD_ONION arguments"
    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACK; suggested strict whitelist validation, test precondition check, and non-blocking cleanups for m_service_id and m_service"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5526250741",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Character blacklisting is brittle compared to strictly validating expected base64 characters for KeyBlob",
      "quote": "Instead of chasing bad characters from the Tor router reponses, it would be more robust to only allow legit characters and frown upon anything else.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author replied in c:5545894123; fixed by c:5545894123",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5545894123"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5545894123",
      "status_by_quote": "addressed all comments, thank you! ... and @vasild for suggesting strict key-format and service-ID validation."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5097038039",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Space characters in returned keys bypass CRLF checks and allow injecting ADD_ONION arguments such as Port= or Flags=Detach",
      "quote": "The space still gets through. The key goes into ADD_ONION unquoted, and in the control protocol a space is what separates arguments.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author replied in c:5545894123; fixed by c:5545894123",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5545894123"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5545894123",
      "status_by_quote": "Private-key format is now checked when received and before cached reuse, blocking both CRLF and space injection."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5543733038",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Malformed ServiceID in Tor daemon reply is passed unchecked to LookupNumeric() and LogInfo() instead of aborting",
      "quote": "But it must be exactly 56 base32 characters. If it is not, then it is safer to assume malformed reply from Tor, stop the processing right there, and not pass the malformed stuff to other functions.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author replied in c:5545894123; fixed by c:5545894123",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5545894123"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5545894123",
      "status_by_quote": "Service IDs are validated before caching the key or advertising the service"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3938169152",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Cached onion private key files might not have restrictive owner-only file permissions",
      "quote": "should we explicitly enforce owner-only permissions when writing the cached onion private key ?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "accepted by winterrdog in rc:3958710162 after umask explanation",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3958710162",
      "status_by_quote": "ah, yes! case closed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4106309269",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Ensure the cached key file does not exist before running the test so assert_equal does not pass falsely",
      "quote": "Would be good here to ensure that the key did not exist or if it existed did not contain exactly the value of `valid_private_key` before this snippet runs.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author noted unlink is already in restart_with_mock() and added an explicit assertion",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4107959322"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4107959322",
      "status_by_quote": "The unlink seems to be present in `restart_with_mock()` already - added `assert not key_path.exists()` immediately after"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4110730795",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Turn m_service_id into a local variable inside TorController::add_onion_cb() since it is not used elsewhere",
      "quote": "why is this even a member variable? It is used only inside TorController::add_onion_cb(). I think it should be turned into a local variable inside the method.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4110730795",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Assign m_service to a local variable and only assign to the member variable after validating it",
      "quote": "it is assigned from LookupNumeric() and then checked whether is valid. If not, it will remain with its invalid value.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],

    {

  "notes": "Added vasild's ACK (r:5325206990) and new suggestions from rc:4110730795 proposing m_service_id be made local and m_service assignment deferred until after validation."
